spec.scope: Shield creation, 30.15% of the skill user's own final Max HP; continuous (no durationSec)
spec.durationSemantics: 'This effect is continuous' = permanent shield; in v1 the boss deals no damage, so nothing ever breaks it — Delusion status is effectively active from t=0 for the whole fight
spec.triggerIdentity: passive (activates at start of battle), first-apply frame 0
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropped entirely as 'defensive, no damage' — violating the tandem rule: a shield emission drives 'shielded' triggers and, structurally, the Delusion status that gates every skill2 self buff
spec.distinguishingAssertion: The override carries a shield effect (kind:'shield', maxHpPct:30.15, no durationSec) on a passive self block; and the skill2 Delusion-gated buffs (atkPct 93.39 / burstGenPct 70.4) are present from frame 0 — GREEN if the shield block exists and the gated buffs are live whole-fight, RED if the shield was dropped AND the gated buffs were dropped with it as 'Delusion unmodelable'
spec.inertness: In isolation the shield moves zero damage — totals(res)['label'] must be unchanged when only the shield effect is stripped, PROVIDED the skill2 buffs are encoded as plain passives rather than shield-state-gated

spec.kitLine: ■ when Delusion status ends: Delusion Shattered
spec.scope: Untargetability (1s × count, removed on direct hit) + self-stun (1s per stack), up to 2 activations
spec.durationSemantics: 1 sec per Delusion Shattered stack; stack-scaled seconds
spec.triggerIdentity: status-end trigger — UNREACHABLE in v1: the boss deals no damage, shields never break, Delusion never ends
spec.targetSet: self (note: the stun in Effect 2 reads as affecting SELF per the ■ header — it would halt her own firing if it ever fired)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Modeling the stun as live (kind:'stun' on some proxy trigger) — which would wrongly cut Label's fire uptime; or modeling untargetability as a damage-relevant effect
spec.distinguishingAssertion: NO stun effect ever fires: Label's shot cadence is continuous — count her shot events across the fight and assert the inter-shot gaps never exceed reload (81f) + fire-cycle bounds; also no second shield application event ever occurs
spec.inertness: Must move nothing; must appear verbatim in unmodeled.skill1

spec.kitLine: ■ normal attack while not in Delusion → Delusion
spec.scope: Shield re-application (30.15% Max HP) on normal attack when Delusion is down
spec.triggerIdentity: shotFired gated on not-in-Delusion — UNREACHABLE (Delusion never lapses in v1)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding as an ungated shotFired shield re-application, spamming a shield event (and any teammate's 'shielded' trigger) on every trigger pull
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Exactly ONE shield application at frame 0 across the whole fight — no per-shot shield re-emissions; a teammate patched with a 'shielded'-trigger test block would fire once, not per-shot
spec.inertness: Zero damage movement; verbatim in unmodeled.skill1

spec.scope: Shield re-application on her own burst cast when Delusion is down
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast gated on not-in-Delusion — UNREACHABLE (Delusion never lapses)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Ungated burstCast shield re-application every rotation (harmless alone, but wrong structurally and it re-fires 'shielded' consumers)
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Same as above: exactly one shield application per battle
spec.inertness: Zero damage movement; verbatim in unmodeled.skill1

spec.kitLine: ■ start: allies dmg taken from Electric ▼70.4%
spec.scope: Damage-taken reduction vs Electric Code enemies only; allies except self
spec.durationSemantics: 5 sec, 'Activates 1 time(s) per battle' — one-shot window
spec.triggerIdentity: passive at battle start, once per battle
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding as a damageTakenPct boss debuff (positive = boss takes more) — 'Damage taken ▼' here is a defensive ALLY buff, not a boss Damage-Taken ▲ debuff; conflating them would add phantom team damage
spec.distinguishingAssertion: NO buffApply with stat 'damageTakenPct' ever appears from Label's blocks; team totals unchanged when this line's block (if authored) is stripped
spec.inertness: Fully inert (boss deals no damage in v1; fixture boss is Fire, not Electric); verbatim in unmodeled.skill2

spec.scope: Her OWN burst-gauge contribution only (burstGenPct), not team-wide gauge speed
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' while in Delusion; Delusion is permanent in v1 → whole-fight passive
spec.triggerIdentity: passive (the Delusion gate is permanently satisfied from t=0); acceptable alternate encoding is a requiresShielded-gated passive with the permanent self-shield — observably identical
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipped as 'utility, not damage' — but gauge speed is rotation-load-bearing (moves full-burst timing/counts); second misread: applied team-wide instead of self-only
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply {stat:'burstGenPct', value:70.4, targetSlug:'label'} at frame 0 and on NO other unit; and withPatchedOverride('label', o => zero the value) shifts the first fullBurstStart frame later (gauge fills slower) — GREEN under self-scoped live encoding, RED if omitted or team-scoped
spec.inertness: Teammates' buffApply streams carry no burstGenPct from Label

spec.scope: Generic self ATK, scales her own ATK — stat 'atkPct' (raw percentage), NOT casterAtkPct
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' while in Delusion → permanent (Delusion never ends in v1); no expiry, no refresh cycle
spec.nearestWrongModel: Tying it to a fragile shield-alive tracker or a timed window that lapses (any lapse under-credits); or emitting as casterAtkPct (would flat-resolve and change the emitted value shape)
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply {stat:'atkPct', value:93.39, targetSlug:'label'} at frame 0 with NO expiresFrame lapse mid-fight (no re-apply churn needed); withPatchedOverride zeroing it drops totals(res)['label'] materially — GREEN under permanent passive, RED under any windowed/lapsing encoding
spec.inertness: Applies to Label only — no ally buffApply carries this stat from her

spec.kitLine: ■ while Delusion: dmg taken from Electric ▼70.4%
spec.scope: Self damage-taken reduction vs Electric enemies
spec.nearestWrongModel: Same damageTakenPct-debuff conflation as the skill2 ally line
spec.distinguishingAssertion: No damageTakenPct buffApply from Label; boss-held-debuff filter (casterIdx===null) finds nothing attributable to her

spec.kitLine: ■ while Shared Delusion: allies ATK ▲80.36% of user's ATK
spec.scope: ATK as a % of the SKILL USER'S ATK — a caster-scaled FLAT add (stat 'casterAtkPct'), NOT a % of each target's own ATK
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' means ONLY while Shared Delusion is up — and Shared Delusion is a 10-second status opened by her burst cast. NOT permanent. Uptime is 10s per Label burst (her burst CD 20s + rotation), i.e. windowed ≤~50%
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (Label's OWN burst opens Shared Delusion) with a 10s window; NOT fullBurstEnter — although she is Burst I so the two nearly coincide in a comp where she is the sole B1, the buff must key to HER cast and its 10s clock, not to team FB entry
spec.targetSet: allies excludeSelf — Label herself does NOT receive it (she already has her own 93.39%)
spec.nearestWrongModel: The word 'continuously' read as PERMANENT uptime (a passive allies-buff) — massive over-credit outside the 10s windows. Runner-up misreads: stat atkPct 80.36 (scales each ally's own ATK — wrong magnitude for a Defender caster at 78,707 static), or including self
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply {stat:'casterAtkPct'} events on liter/crown/helm slots with value ≈ 0.8036 × Label's staticAtk (a FLAT ATK number per the harness note, not 80.36), appearing at each Label burstCast frame with expiresFrame ≈ cast+600, and NEVER targeting Label's own index; critically, NO such buffApply exists at frame 0 / before her first burst cast — GREEN under 10s-windowed burstCast encoding, RED under a permanent passive or an atkPct/self-inclusive encoding
spec.inertness: Between windows (e.g. frame 0 → first cast) allies carry no casterAtkPct from Label; Label's own damage unchanged when this block is stripped

spec.scope: Self Max HP percentage buff (maxHpPct / targetMaxHpPct-style; emitted under stat 'maxHpFlat' per the harness note)
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropped as pure-defensive — the taxonomy says keep HP stat buffs even when the engine treats them inert (future scaler feed); the opposite misread is wiring it to lift the 30.15% shield magnitude mid-fight (shields have no HP pool — nothing to lift)
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply with stat 'maxHpFlat' on Label at each burstCast with expiresFrame ≈ cast+600; AND totals are byte-identical when it is stripped (Label has no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer, so it must be present-but-inert)
spec.inertness: Must move ZERO damage for every unit in the comp — this is the assertion's core

spec.scope: Dual-natured: the invulnerability mechanics are defensive/inert (no shield HP pool in v1), but this line is the SOLE OPENER of the Shared Delusion status window that gates the skill2 ally ATK buff — the 10s window IS the load-bearing content
spec.durationSemantics: 10 seconds from her burst cast; the skill2 ally buff's real duration derives from HERE
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — whatever encoding is chosen (a 10s durationSec on the skill2-sourced burstCast block is the natural one), the window must open on HER cast and close 10s later
spec.targetSet: self (status holder); downstream beneficiaries are the skill2 line's allies-excludeSelf
spec.nearestWrongModel: Treating the whole burst line as defensive fluff and dropping it — which silently orphans the skill2 Shared-Delusion gate and either kills the ally buff entirely (under-credit) or leaves it permanently on (over-credit, if the gate was dropped with it)
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Same event-log assertion as the skill2 ally line: the ally casterAtkPct windows exist, are 10s long, and are anchored to Label's burstCast frames — the burst's window semantics and the skill2 buff must agree; invulnerability prose itself appears in unmodeled.burst
spec.inertness: No damage effect from the invulnerability itself; no flatDamage/dot sourced from the burst

skill1: Activates when Delusion status ends: Delusion Shattered (up to 2 times) — Imagined Heartbreak untargetability (1 sec x count, removed upon taking a direct hit) and self-stun (1 sec per stack); unreachable in v1 (boss deals no damage, the shield never breaks, Delusion never ends)
Delusion re-application on normal attack while not in Delusion status (unreachable — Delusion never lapses)
Delusion re-application on Burst Skill use while not in Delusion status (unreachable — Delusion never lapses)

While Delusion: self Damage taken from Electric Code enemies ▼ 70.4% continuously (defensive)
burst: The Shield created by Label becomes invulnerable for 10 sec — invulnerability mechanics themselves (no shield HP pool in v1); the 10s Shared Delusion WINDOW it opens IS modeled as the gate for the skill2 ally ATK buff

notes: FIXTURE HAZARD (top reconcile item): Label is a BURST I unit — controlComp(label) is the wrong fixture. controlComp puts the carry in the B3 slot with liter already at B1; a Burst-I carry there either never casts or collides with liter in first-ready selection, and every burstCast-keyed line (the Shared Delusion window, the Max HP buff) silently never fires — tests would go green-by-vacuity. The tests MUST build a custom CompOptions with Label as the sole B1 (plus a B2 and a B3) so her burst actually casts each rotation; assert at least one burstCast event with Label's srcSlot before trusting any burst-keyed assertion. EXPECTED SHARED-PRIOR MISREADS: (1) 'continuously' on the Shared Delusion ally line read as PERMANENT — the biggest over-credit risk; its true duration is the burst's 10s status window, so uptime is rotation-bound (~10s per ~20s+ burst cycle). (2) 'ATK ▲ 80.36% of the skill user's ATK' encoded as atkPct instead of casterAtkPct — the harness flat-resolves casterAtkPct at apply time (value = 0.8036 × Label's staticAtk, and she is a DEFENDER at the low class-static ATK), so the two encodings differ in both event shape and magnitude; assert on the emitted flat value. (3) The Delusion-gated skill2 self buffs are correctly PERMANENT (the boss never breaks the shield in v1) — a reviewer expecting windows here would be wrong in the opposite direction; the clean encoding is plain passives with the shield block retained for tandem ('shielded' consumers) and structural faithfulness. (4) Burst Gauge filling ▲70.4% is rotation-load-bearing (self burstGenPct) — dropping it as 'utility' shifts first-FB timing and FB counts, the exact observable the board grades. All magnitudes are kit-literal (DATAMINED); no ⚑ estimates are required for this kit — a spec inventing a cadence or damage proc here should itself be treated as a misread.
